description: Java class implementing a SOAP event handler for processing SOAP requests and WSDL generation within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SOAPEventHandler
classes.description: Handles SOAP requests, including WSDL retrieval and invoking services via SOAP envelopes within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the servlet context.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main method to process incoming SOAP requests, handle WSDL requests, and invoke services.

methods.name: validateSOAPBody
methods.description: Validates that the SOAP body contains exactly one service call request.

methods.name: createAndSendSOAPResponse
methods.description: Creates a SOAP response envelope with service results and sends it back to the client.

methods.name: sendError
methods.description: Sends an error message as a SOAP response.

methods.name: getLocationURI
methods.description: Constructs the request's full location URI.
